## Annotator checklist

- [ ] I read the paper myself, and `reading` says how much (full text / partial text / abstract only)
- [ ] Self-reference depth, feedback source, loop automation and evidence strength each cite the paper
- [ ] Anything I was unsure about is in `review_points`, each with options and my recommendation
- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/check_data.py`
- [ ] I did not fill in an id or confirmation fields, and did not change `data/papers.tsv`

The annotation appears on the issue page automatically. A confirmer checks it there and comments `/confirm`; this pull request is then closed automatically and the workflow adds the paper to the list.
